title: Learning DataStorage Use Limits
author: MapleStory Worlds Creator Center
summary: This official intermediate lesson explains DataStorage request credits, FunctionGroups, and how usage is calculated across a released World instance.

sections.title: Credit model
items: DataStorage usage is calculated across the entire released World instance.
Each request consumes credits based on its FunctionGroup and size.
Creators should monitor critical reports before hard limits are introduced.

notes: Structured summary verified against the official Creator Center lesson on 2026-07-27.
steps: Identify the DataStorage function being called.
Map it to the documented FunctionGroup.
Estimate request credits and request size.
Review usage reports and reduce excessive calls.
